title: Reseller Programme Schedule: Renewal Discount on Maximum-Term Extensions of Domain Registrations
content:
**Harborline reseller programme — Domain Registrations maximum-term extensions**

The maximum-term reseller discount is the percentage discount that applies to a maximum-term extension of a Domain Registrations domain. It follows the tier of the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts account.

**Schedule.** The maximum-term reseller discount is the domain renewal discount percentage that Harborline Customer Accounts sets for the customer's account tier:

| Account tier (Harborline Customer Accounts) | Maximum-term reseller discount |
|---|---|
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | the Platinum domain renewal discount percentage |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | the Gold domain renewal discount percentage |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | the Silver domain renewal discount percentage |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | the Bronze domain renewal discount percentage |
| every other account | none |

**Reading the schedule.**
- The tier is the one the account record shows; the percentage for each reseller tier is the figure Harborline Customer Accounts publishes for that tier as its domain renewal discount.
- A Harborline Personal Account or Harborline Business Account is an "other account" here and takes no maximum-term reseller discount.
- The discount is a percentage of the renewal part of the extension only; the ICANN fee is never discounted.

**Hypothetical illustration.** If a reseller tier's published domain renewal discount were 9 per cent (an invented figure), an extension whose renewal part came to USD 200.00 would be reduced by 9 per cent of that part.
